title: 第八章 任务完成-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
“不介意，不介意，我怎么会介意呢，能有一个安全的地方住我已经很满足了。”赵洁连忙说道。

    在拿到房卡之后，赵洁有拿了一些食物，然后开开心心的上楼去了。

    其他人见赵洁在进去之后久久的没有走出来，纷纷猜测她是不是已经死了，毕竟这家店的店长残暴程度可见一斑，直接死无全尸的那种。

    而一行占据了一处安全点正在休息的一行人在注意到赵洁久久的没有从里面走出来之后，对着旁边为首的男人说道：“队长，这个地方我觉得很有问题。”

    被叫做队长的男人一声黑色的战斗服，在听到队员的话之后，说道：“我能不知道有问题，但就算是有问题，以我们现在的能力也阻止不了。”

    “对啊，小六，刚刚第一个人冲进去的那个人的下场我们可是都看着的，现在我们已经跟上面失去了联系，只能独自战斗，一切都必须万分小心才信。”

    被叫做小六的青年垂眸点了点头，“我知道了。”

    这时，刚刚说话，身上带着一丝书生气的青年再次说道：“其实我觉得刚刚那个女人未必是死了，毕竟从我们刚刚观察的结果来看，这应该是一家店，而那第一个人明显是违反的规则，如果我们不违反规则，说不定就不会有危险了，队长你觉得呢。”

    被叫做队长的男人没有立刻回应，那双深沉的目光锁定在那扇敞开的大门上，透过那扇门，隐约能够看到里面的货架上堆满了各式各样的物资。

    空气中火锅的香气依旧没有消失，但已经变得很淡了，看来对方已经吃饱了。

    “走吧，过去看看，一有异常，立刻撤退！”他对着身边的队员沉声吩咐道。

    “是！”

    游戏商店内，爻雪刚将空间玉坠的事情处理好，在融合完成之后，空间背包制作间一天能够生产出一个一级背包，背包里面有十个空格，就跟游戏里面的背包里面，相同的物品能够叠加，但最多不能超过一百，而想要解锁更高级的背包，就需要将游戏商店升级才行。

    刚跟系统沟通完空间背包的事情，一抬头，就看到一群穿着统一战斗服的男人朝着自己这边走来。

    新手任务这不就完成了嘛。

    爻雪的脸上扬起一抹淡淡又不失礼貌的笑容。

    “欢迎光临，请问有什么需要帮忙的吗？”

    从这些人的眼神中，她看到了警惕，这些人对她充满了警惕。

    好半晌之后，为首的男人缓缓开口道：“我们需要一些食物和水。”

    “没问题，食物和水都在那边，价格在下面写着，另外，购物车在那边。”

    爻雪指了指一个方向，那里放着几辆购物车，是她之前在国外超市大采购的时候顺手牵羊来的，放在那里也算是废物利用了，当然，这些购物车并不是重点，重点是那旁边的住宿提醒。

    果然，男人一眼就看到了住宿提醒以及价格。

    “这东西能不能换积分？”

    说着，男人从口袋里面掏出了一枚如同水晶一样的东西，白色，并非是完全透明，而是半透明。

    这东西是从那边变异的人和动物里面找出来的，是他们队伍里面的小六发现的。

    小六平时没什么爱好，就爱看点末世小说，再杀死第一只变异的怪物之后，他非说里面有晶核，是好东西，想要找找看，没想到竟然真的就被他给找到了。

content_en:
"I don't mind, I don't mind, why would I mind? I'm very satisfied to have a safe place to live." Zhao Jie said quickly.

After getting the room card, Zhao Jieyou took some food and went upstairs happily.

Seeing that Zhao Jie didn’t come out for a long time after entering, others speculated whether she was already dead. After all, the cruelty of the manager of this store was evident, as he died without a complete body.

After a group of people who occupied a safe spot and were resting noticed that Zhao Jie had not come out for a long time, they said to the man next to them: "Captain, I think there is something wrong with this place."

The man called captain put on a black battle suit. After hearing what the team members said, he said: "I don't know if there is a problem, but even if there is a problem, we can't stop it with our current capabilities."

"Yes, Xiao Liu, we all watched the fate of the first person who rushed in. Now we have lost contact with the above and can only fight alone. We must be extremely careful in everything."

The young man called Xiaoliu lowered his eyes and nodded, "I understand."

At this time, the young man who had just spoken with a hint of bookishness said again: "Actually, I think the woman just now may not be dead. After all, judging from the results of our observation just now, this should be a store, and the first person obviously violated the rules. If we don't violate the rules, maybe there will be no danger. Captain, what do you think?"

The man called captain did not respond immediately. His deep eyes were locked on the open door. Through the door, he could vaguely see the shelves inside filled with various supplies.

The aroma of the hot pot in the air still hasn't disappeared, but it has become very faint. It seems that the other party is full.

"Let's go, go over and take a look. If anything unusual happens, retreat immediately!" He said in a deep voice to the team members around him.

"Yes!"

In the game store, Yao Xuegang has just taken care of the space jade pendant. After the integration is completed, the space backpack production room can produce a first-level backpack a day. There are ten spaces in the backpack, just like the backpack in the game. The same items can be stacked, but the maximum cannot exceed one hundred. To unlock more advanced backpacks, you need to upgrade the game store.

Having just finished communicating with the system about the space backpack, when I looked up, I saw a group of men wearing uniforms walking towards me.

Isn’t the novice mission completed now?

A faint yet polite smile appeared on Yaoxue's face.

“Welcome, may I help you?”

From the eyes of these people, she saw vigilance. These people were full of vigilance towards her.

After a long while, the leading man slowly said: "We need some food and water."

“No problem, the food and water are over there, the prices are written below, and the shopping cart is over there.”

Yaoxue pointed in one direction. There were several shopping carts there. She had picked them up when she was shopping in a foreign supermarket. Putting them there could be regarded as waste. Of course, these shopping carts are not the focus. The focus is the accommodation reminder next to them.

Sure enough, the man saw the accommodation reminder and price at a glance.

“Can this thing be exchanged for points?”

As he spoke, the man took out a crystal-like thing from his pocket. It was white, not completely transparent, but translucent.

This thing was found from the mutated people and animals over there, and was discovered by Xiao Liu in their team.

Xiaoliu usually doesn’t have any hobbies, he just likes to read apocalyptic novels. After killing the first mutated monster, he insisted that there was a crystal core in it, which was a good thing, and wanted to look for it. Unexpectedly, he actually found it.
title_en: Chapter 8 Mission Completed - "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"
